dp_welcome_horde.name: The Long Road West
dp_welcome_horde.text: Fresh off the Mesa, eh? Good. The Crossing sits dead center of the plains — neutral ground, caravan folk, the only warm meal for miles. Caravan Master Jorah runs it. Tell him Ashfall Post still stands.

objectives.label: Report to Caravan Master Jorah at The Crossing

dp_welcome_alliance.name: The Long Road East
dp_welcome_alliance.text: The Vale is behind you now. Out here the only law is the road, and the road runs to The Crossing. Caravan Master Jorah keeps the peace there — neutral ground, mind your manners. Let him know Fairwind Landing holds.

objectives.label: Report to Caravan Master Jorah at The Crossing

dp_striders.name: Striders of the Plains
dp_striders.text: See those long-legged birds out west? Plains striders. Harmless-looking, until one kicks a hole in your wagon. Or your chest. The caravans need the western road thinned — ten striders.

dp_prowler_pelts.name: Prowler Pelts
dp_prowler_pelts.text: Dust prowler pelts fetch a fine price back east, and my buyers don't ask how I got them. The prowlers run northeast of here. Eight pelts, and I'll cut you in.

dp_oasis.name: The Shimmering Oasis
dp_oasis.text: The spirits speak of the oasis south of here — the only sweet water for a day's walk in any direction. Something has been drinking it low. Go. Stand at the water's edge and tell me what you feel.

dp_raptor_problem.name: The Raptor Problem
dp_raptor_problem.text: Quill raptors in the eastern scrub — smarter than the canyon breed, and they've learned what caravans carry. Twelve of them, scout. Make the east road safe enough to lie about.

dp_raptor_eggs.name: Eggs of the Quillfang
dp_raptor_eggs.text: Since you're already knee-deep in raptors: their eggs sell for more than the pelts, the meat, and your fee combined. Six speckled eggs from the eastern nests. Try not to think about the mothers.

dp_kharvani_raiders.name: The Kharvani
dp_kharvani_raiders.text: The Kharvani clans have burned three caravans this season. They mass in the southwest, around their great totem. I don't like it any more than you will — but it's them or the road. Kill twelve raiders.

dp_war_totems.name: War Totems
dp_war_totems.text: The Kharvani carve war totems before a great raid — one for each warband sworn to fight. Count the totems and we count their army. Bring me eight from the raiders' camps.

dp_windcallers.name: Silence the Windcallers
dp_windcallers.text: Eight totems. Eight warbands. This is no raid — it is a war, and the Kharvani windcallers are its voice, singing the clans together across the plains. Silence eight of them.

dp_long_patrol.name: The Long Patrol
dp_long_patrol.text: I need a full sweep of the plains and only one set of boots to do it. Ride the circuit: the harpy bluffs in the northwest, the scorpid flats in the south, and the old watchstone in the far northeast. Report what you see.

dp_stingers.name: Stingers of the Flats
dp_stingers.text: A plains scorpid took a caravan guard off his feet last week — through a boot, through the bone. The southern flats crawl with them. Ten dead scorpids and the south route reopens.

dp_harpies.name: Thieves of the Bluffs
dp_harpies.text: Dustwind harpies hold the northwestern bluffs and rob everything that walks below — grain, tools, once an entire mule. Ten harpies. The bluffs won't miss them.

dp_the_warlord.name: Warlord of the Kharvani
dp_the_warlord.text: Khar Duskmane. Warlord of the eight warbands. While he lives, the clans have one will, and that will is fire and ruin. He stands at the great totem in the far southwest, ringed by his best. This is a task for a small army — or one very careful soul. End him.

dp_ancient_thunderer.name: The Ancient Thunderer
dp_ancient_thunderer.text: There's a beast out by the old watchstone that the plains folk won't even name. A raptor old as the stones, big as a wagon, blue like a storm rolling in. Every year it takes a herd. No one's ever collected the bounty. It's a big bounty.
